name: Köhles Kulinarium
kurzbeschreibung:
**Serfaus’ Culinary Delights at Köhles**

Indulge in hearty Alpine flavors at **Köhles Kulinarium**, where traditional Tyrolean cuisine meets rustic charm. Savor the crispy layers of **Kaiserschmarrn**, melt in your mouth **Speckknödel**, or warm up with a steaming bowl of **Käsespätzle**. Fresh mountain air and cozy ambiance make every meal an experience—just steps away from Serfaus’ slopes.
